s.d: ἀ-σύμφωνος, -ον [in LXX: Wis.18:10, Da, LXX, Bel 1:15 * ;] dissonant, discordant; metaphorically, at variance: πρὸς ἀλλήλους, [[acts 28 25|Act.28:25.]]† (AS)

ἀ-σύνετος, -ον [in LXX: [[deuteronomy 32 21|Deu.32:21]] (נָבָל). [[job 13 2|Job.13:2]] (נָפַל), [[psalms 92 6|Psa.92:6]] (כְּסִיל), [[psalms 76 5|Psa.76:5]], Wis.2:1-24, Sir.6:1-37 * ;] without understanding or discernment: [[matthew 15 16|Mat.15:16]], [[mark 7 18|Mrk.7:18]] (Swete, in l), [[romans 1 21|Rom.1:21, 31 10:19]] (for an ex. of its use in the moral sense, see MM, see word).† (AS)

ἀ-σύν-θετος, -ον (συντίθεμαι ν. M, Pr., 222; MM, see word), [in LXX: [[jeremiah 3 7|Jer.3:7-11]] (בָּגַד)* ;] false to engagements, not keeping covenant, faithless (MM, see word): [[romans 1 31|Rom.1:31.]]† (AS)

ἀσφάλεια, -ας, ἡ (ἀσφαλής), [in LXX for בָּטַח, etc. ;] 1. firmness. 2. certainty: [[luke 1 4|Luk.1:4.]] 3. security: [[acts 5 23|Act.5:23]], [[1-thessalonians 5 3|1Th.5:3]]. (In π. it is used as a law-term, proof, security; see MM, see word; M, Th., l.with)† (AS)

ἀσφαλής, -ές (ἀ- neg., σφάλλω, to trip up), [in LXX for אָשַׁר pu., etc. ;] certain, secure, safe: [[acts 21 34|Act.21:34 22:30 25:26]], [[philippians 3 1|Php.3:1]], [[hebrews 6 19|Heb.6:19]] (MM, see word).† (AS)

ἀσφαλίζω (ἀσφαλής), [in LXX: [[nehemiah 3 15|Neh.3:15]] (חָזַק hi.), [[isaiah 41 10|Isa.41:10]] (תָּמַךְ), Wis.4:17 10:12 13:15 * ;] to make firm, secure: mid., [[matthew 27 65|Mat.27:65-66]], [[acts 16 24|Act.16:24]]; pass., [[matthew 27 64|Mat.27:64]] (MM, see word).† (AS)

ἀσφαλῶς adv., [in LXX: [[genesis 34 25|Gen.34:25]] (בֶּטַח), Tob.6:4, Wis.18:6, Bar.5:7, 1Ma.6:40, 3Ma.7:6 * ;] (a) safely: [[mark 14 44|Mrk.14:44]], [[acts 16 23|Act.16:23]]; (b) assuredly: [[acts 2 36|Act.2:36.]]† (AS)

ἀσχημονέω, -ῶ (ἀσχήμαων), [in LXX: [[ezekiel 16 7|Eze.16:7, 22 16:39 23:29]] (עֶרְיָה); [[deuteronomy 25 3|Deu.25:3]] (קָלָה ni.)* ;] to act unbecomingly, behave dishonourably: [[1-corinthians 13 5|1Co.13:5;]] before ἐπί, ib. [[1-corinthians 7 36|1Co.7:36]] (MM, see word).† (AS)

ἀσχημοσύνη, -ης, ή (ἀσχήμων), [in LXX chiefly for עֶרְוָה ;] unseemliness: [[romans 1 27|Rom.1:27]] (MM, see word); euphemism for ἡ αἰσχύνη, as frequently in LXX, shame, nakedness: [[revelation 16 15|Rev.16:15.]]† (AS)

ἀσχήμων, -ον (ἀ- neg., σχῆμα) [in LXX: [[genesis 34 7|Gen.34:7]] (נְבָלָה), [[deuteronomy 24 1|Deu.24:1]] (עֶרְוָה), Wis.2:20, Da TH Sus 1:63, 2Ma.9:2 * ;] 1. shapeless. 2. uncomely, unseemly: [[1-corinthians 12 23|1Co.12:23.]]† (AS)

ἀσωτία, -ας, ή (ἀ- neg., σώζω), [in LXX: [[proverbs 28 7|Pro.28:7]] (זָלַל), 2Ma.6:4 * ;] prodigality, wastefulness, profligacy: [[ephesians 5 18|Eph.5:18]], [[titus 1 6|Tit.1:6]], [[1-peter 4 4|1Pe.4:4]] (MM, see word).† SYN.: ἀσέλγεια, q.v (AS)

ἀσώτως adv. (ἄσωτος, prodigal, wasteful), [in LXX for סָרַר, [[proverbs 7 11|Pro.7:11]] * ;] wastefully: [[luke 15 13|Luk.15:13]] (EV, in riotous living; but not necessarily dissolute; cf. MM, ut supr.; Milligan, NTD, 79).† (AS)

ἀτακτέω -ῶ (ἄτακτος), primarily, of soldiers marching, to be out of order, to quit the ranks; hence, metaphorically, to be remiss, fail in the performance of duty (in π., of truancy on the part of an apprentice): [[2-thessalonians 3 7|2Th.3:7]] (on ἀ. and its cognates, see M, Th., 152 ff.; MM, s.vv.).† (AS)

ἀ-τακτος, -ον (τάσσω), [in LXX: 3Ma.1:19 * ;] out of order, out of place (Lat. inordinatus), frequently of soldiers not keeping the ranks, or an army in disarray (cf. 3Ma.1:19); hence, metaphorically, irregular, disorderly (see previous word): [[1-thessalonians 5 14|1Th.5:14.]]† (AS)
ἀ-τάκτως adv., [in Sm.: [[2-kings 9 20|4Ki.9:20]] * ;] disorderly, irregularly: [[2-thessalonians 3 6|2Th.3:6 3:11]].† (AS)

ἄτεκνος, -ον (τέκνον), [in LXX: [[genesis 15 2|Gen.15:2]], [[leviticus 20 20|Lev.20:20-21]] (עֲרִירִי), [[isaiah 49 21|Isa.49:21]], [[jeremiah 18 21|Jer.18:21]] (שָׁכֹל), Sir.16:3 * ;] childless: [[luke 20 28|Luk.20:28-29.]]† (AS)

ἀτενίζω (ἀτενής, strained, intent; τείνω), [in LXX: I [[esther 6 28|Est.6:28]], 3Ma.2:26 * ;] to look fixedly, gaze (MM, see word): with dative of person(s), gaze upon: [[luke 4 20|Luk.4:20 22:56]], [[acts 3 12|Act.3:12 10:4 14:9 23:1]]; before εἰς, with accusative of person(s), [[acts 3 4|Act.3:4 6:15 13:9]]; metaphorically, [[acts 1 10|Act.1:10 7:55 11:6]], [[2-corinthians 3 7|2Co.3:7 3:13]].† (AS)
ἄτερ prep., [in LXX: 2Ma.12:15 * ;] in cl. most frequently in poets; without, apart from: with genitive, [[luke 22 6|Luk.22:6, 35]] (for exx. from π., see MM, see word).† (AS)

ἀτιμάζω (ἄτιμος), [in LXX for בּוּז, קָלָה, etc. ;] to dishonour, insult: [[mark 12 4|Mrk.12:4]], TTr., mg., WH, [[luke 20 11|Luk.20:11]], [[john 8 49|Jhn.8:49]], [[romans 2 23|Rom.2:23]], [[james 2 6|Jas.2:6]]; pass.: [[acts 5 41|Act.5:41]], [[romans 1 24|Rom.1:24]] (cf ἀτιμάω).† (AS)

ἀτιμία, -ας, ἡ (ἄτιμος) [in LXX for כְּלִמָּה, קָלוֹן, etc. ;] dishonour, disgrace: [[1-corinthians 11 14|1Co.11:14]], [[2-corinthians 6 8|2Co.6:8]]; εἰς ἀ., [[romans 9 21|Rom.9:21]], [[2-timothy 2 20|2Ti.2:20]]; ἐν ἀ., [[1-corinthians 15 43|1Co.15:43;]] κατ᾽ ἀ., [[2-corinthians 11 21|2Co.11:21;]] πάθη ἀτιμίας, base passions, [[romans 1 26|Rom.1:26.]]† (AS)

ἄτιμος, -ον (τιμή), [in LXX: [[isaiah 3 5|Isa.3:5]] (קָלָה ni.), [[isaiah 53 3|Isa.53:3]] (בָּזָה), [[job 30 4|Job.30:4]], 8 (שֵׁם בְּלִי), שֵׁם בְּלִי), Wis.5:1-23, Sir.1:1-30 * ;] without honour, dishonoured, despised: [[matthew 13 57|Mat.13:57]], [[mark 6 4|Mrk.6:4]], [[1-corinthians 4 10|1Co.4:10]]; comp., [[1-corinthians 12 23|1Co.12:23.]]† (AS)
ἀτιμόω, -ῶ (ἄτιμος), [in LXX chiefly for בָּזָה ;] = ἀτιμάζω, to dishonour, treat with indignity: [[mark 12 4|Mrk.12:4]], Rec.† (AS)
ἀτμίς, -ίδος, ἡ [in LXX for עָנַן, תִּמֹּר, etc. ;] vapour: [[james 4 14|Jas.4:14;]] ἀ. καπνοῦ, [[acts 2 19|Act.2:19]] (LXX).† (AS)
ἄ-τομος, -ον (τέμνω), [in Sm.: [[isaiah 54 8|Isa.54:8]] (MM, see word) * ;] indivisible; of time, ἄτομον, a moment: ἐν ἄ., [[1-corinthians 15 52|1Co.15:52.]]† (AS)

ἄ-τοπος, -ον (τόπος), [in LXX: [[job 4 8|Job.4:8 11:11]], [[proverbs 30 20|Pro.30:20]], al., for אָוֶן, etc. ;] 1. out of place, not befitting. 2. marvellous, strange (of symptoms, Hipp.): [[acts 28 6|Act.28:6;]] hence, in late Greek, with ethical sense, 3. improper, unrighteous (so in LXX, and for exx. from π., see M, Th., l.with; MM, see word): [[luke 23 41|Luk.23:41]], [[acts 25 5|Act.25:5]], [[2-thessalonians 3 2|2Th.3:2]].† (AS)
Ἀτταλία (Rec. -άλεια), -υς, ἡ Attalia, a city of Pamphylia: [[acts 14 25|Act.14:25.]]† (AS)

αὐγάζω (αὐγή), [in LXX: [[leviticus 13 24|Lev.13:24-28, 38 14:56]] (בֹּהֶרֶת) [[leviticus 13 39|Lev.13:39]] (כֵּהֶה)* ;] 1. Trans. (cl.), to irradiate. 2. Intrans. (a) (poët.), to see clearly (so perh. 2 Co, l.with; MM, see word) (b) as in LXX, to shine forth: [[2-corinthians 4 4|2Co.4:4]] (cf. δι-, κατ-αυγάζω).† (AS)

αὐγή, -ῆς, ἡ [in LXX: [[isaiah 59 9|Isa.59:9]] (נְגֹהָה), 2Ma.12:9 * ;] 1. brightness 2. Later (as in MGr.; MM, see word), daylight, dawn: [[acts 20 11|Act.20:11]] (Cremer, 118).† SYN.: φέγγος (see Thayer, s. φ.; DB, iii, 44a; Tr., Syn., § xlvi). (AS)
Αὔγουστος, -ου, ὁ (Lat.), Augustus, the Roman Emperor: [[luke 2 1|Luk.2:1]] (cf. Σεβαστός; and see MM, see word).† (AS)

αὐθάδης, -ες (αὐτος, ἥδομαι), [in LXX: [[genesis 49 3|Gen.49:3]], 7 (עַז), [[proverbs 21 24|Pro.21:24]] (יָהִיר)* ;] self-pleasing, arrogant: [[titus 1 7|Tit.1:7]], [[2-peter 2 10|2Pe.2:10]] (Cremer, 654).† SYN.: φίλαυτος (see Tr., Syn., § xciii) (AS)
αὐθαίρετος, -ον (αὐτός, αἱρέομαι), [in Sm.: [[exodus 35 5|Exo.35:5, 22]] * ;] 1. self-chosen. 2. of one's own accord: [[2-corinthians 8 3|2Co.8:3 8:17]].† (AS)

αὐθεντέω, -ῶ (αὐθέντης, i.e. αὐτο- ἕντης, one who acts on his own authority, in π., an autocrat; cf. Wis.12:6; cf. -ία, 3Ma.2:29; -ικος is frequently in vernacular, MM, see word) to govern, exercise authority over: [[1-timothy 2 12|1Ti.2:12.]]† (AS)
αὐλέω, -ῶ (αὐλός), [in Al.: [[1-kings 1 40|3Ki.1:40]] * ;] to play on a flute, to pipe: mid., [[matthew 11 17|Mat.11:17]], [[luke 7 32|Luk.7:32]], [[1-corinthians 14 7|1Co.14:7]].† (AS)

αὐλή, -ῆς, ἡ [in LXX chiefly for חָצֵר ;] 1. in Hom., an open courtyard before a house, hence, an enclosure in the open, a sheepfold: [[john 10 1|Jhn.10:1, 16]] 2. the court, courtyard, round which a house is built: [[matthew 26 3|Mat.26:3, 58 26:69]], [[mark 14 54|Mrk.14:54, 66 15:16]] [[luke 11 21|Luk.11:21 22:55]], [[john 18 15|Jhn.18:15]]; τ. ναοῦ, [[revelation 11 2|Rev.11:2.]] a dwelling, a palace (so, accusative to Grimm-Th., see word): [[matthew 26 3|Mat.26:3, 58]], [[mark 14 54|Mrk.14:54 15:16]], [[luke 11 21|Luk.11:21]], [[john 18 15|Jhn.18:15]] (but see MM, see word; cf. also DB, ii, 25, 287).† (AS)
αὐλητής, -οῦ, ὁ (αὐλέω), a flute-player: [[matthew 9 23|Mat.9:23]], [[revelation 18 22|Rev.18:22]] (MM, see word).† (AS)

αὐλίζομαι (αὐλή), [in LXX chiefly for לוּן ;] 1. prop., to lodge in a courtyard. 2. to lodge in the open. 3. to pass the night, lodge (LXX; MM, see word): [[matthew 21 17|Mat.21:17]], [[luke 21 37|Luk.21:37]].† (AS)
αὐλός, -οῦ, ὁ (ἄω, to blow), [in LXX chiefly for חָלִיל ;] a pipe: [[1-corinthians 14 7|1Co.14:7.]]† (AS)

αὐξάνω (and the earlier form αὔξω, [[ephesians 2 21|Eph.2:21]], [[colossians 2 19|Col.2:19]]; MM, see word), [in LXX chiefly for פָּרָה ;] 1. trans., to make to grow: [[1-corinthians 3 6|1Co.3:6-7]], [[2-corinthians 9 10|2Co.9:10]]. Pass., to grow, increase, become greater: [[matthew 13 32|Mat.13:32]], [[mark 4 8|Mrk.4:8]], [[2-corinthians 10 15|2Co.10:15]], [[colossians 1 6|Col.1:6]]; τῇ ἐπιγνώσει τ. θεοῦ, [[colossians 1 10|Col.1:10;]] εἰς σωτηρίαν, [[1-peter 2 2|1Pe.2:2.]] 2. In later Gk. (but nowhere in LXX), intrans., to grow, increase: of plants, [[matthew 6 28|Mat.6:28]], [[luke 12 27|Luk.12:27 13:19]]; of infants, [[luke 1 80|Luk.1:80 2:40]]; of a multitude, [[acts 7 17|Act.7:17;]] of the increase of the Gospel: ὁ λόγος ηὔξανε, [[acts 6 7|Act.6:7 12:24 19:20]]; of Christ as a leader, [[john 3 30|Jhn.3:30;]] of Christian character: εἰς Χριοτόν, [[ephesians 4 15|Eph.4:15;]] εἰς ναόν, [[ephesians 2 21|Eph.2:21;]] ἐν χάριτι, [[2-peter 3 18|2Pe.3:18;]] τὴν αὔξησιν τ. θεσῦ, [[colossians 2 19|Col.2:19]] (cf. συν, ὑπερ-αυξάνω).† (AS)
αὔξησις, -εως, ἡ (αὔξω), [in LXX: 2Ma.5:16 * ;] increase, growth: [[ephesians 4 16|Eph.4:16]], [[colossians 2 19|Col.2:19]].† (AS)

αὔριον adv., [in LXX for מָחָר ;] to-morrow: [[matthew 6 30|Mat.6:30]], [[luke 12 28|Luk.12:28]], [[acts 23 20|Act.23:20 25:22]], [[1-corinthians 15 32|1Co.15:32]], [[luke 13 32|Luk.13:32-33]], [[james 4 13|Jas.4:13]]; ἡ αὔ. (sc. ἡμέρα, MM, see word), [[matthew 6 34|Mat.6:34]], [[acts 4 3|Act.4:3]]; ἐπὶ τὴν αὔ., [[luke 10 35|Luk.10:35]], [[acts 4 5|Act.4:5]]; τὸ (WH om.) τῆς [[james 4 14|Jas.4:14.]]† (AS)

αὐστηρός, -ά, -όν (αἄω, to dry up) [in LXX: 2Ma.14:30 * ;] prop., stringent, harsh to the taste. Metaphorical, in Inscr., of a rough country; of disposition and manners, strict, severe (as in π., of an inspector; MM, s v): [[luke 19 21|Luk.19:21-22.]]† SYN.: σκληρός (Tr., § xiv) (AS)
αὐτάρκεια, -ας, ἡ (αὐτάρκης, which see), (a) sufficiency (MM, see word): in subjective sense (see Milligan, NTD, 57), [[2-corinthians 9 8|2Co.9:8;]] (b) contentment: [[1-timothy 6 6|1Ti.6:6.]]† (AS)

αὐτάρκης, -ες (αὐτός, ἀρκέω), [in LXX: [[proverbs 30 8|Pro.30:8]] (חֹק), Sir.5:1 11:24 31:28 40:18, 4Ma.9:9 * ;] as in cl., in philosophical sense, self-­sufficient, independent; subjectively, contented: [[philippians 4 11|Php.4:11]] (in non-lit. π., the word means simply enough, sufficient; MM, see word).† (AS)
αὐτο-κατά-κριτος, -ον (αὐτός, κατακρίνω), self-condemned: [[titus 3 11|Tit.3:11]] (Eccl., Cremer, 377; MM, see word).† (AS)

αὐτόματος -ον, and -η, -ον (etym. doubtful; see Boisacq, Prellwitz, see word), [in LXX, [[leviticus 25 5|Lev.25:5, 11]], [[2-kings 19 29|4Ki.19:29]] (סָפִיחַ), [[joshua 6 5|Jos.6:5]], [[job 24 24|Job.24:24]], Wis.17:6 * ;] 1. of persons, acting of one's own will. 2. Of inanimate things and natural agencies, of itself, of its own accord: γῆ [[mark 4 28|Mrk.4:28]] (MM, see word); πύλη, [[acts 12 10|Act.12:10.]]† (AS)
seeing oneself, an eyewitness , (Herdotus Historicus) (ML)

αὐτός, -ή, -ό, determinative pron., in late Gk. much more frequently than in cl. (WM, 178f.; Jannaris, HGG, §1399). 1. Emphatic (so always in nom. exc. when preceded by the art., see infr., iii); (1) self (ipse), expressing opposition, distinction, exclusion, etc., αὐ. ἐκχυθήσεται, [[luke 5 37|Luk.5:37;]] αὐ. ἐγινώσκεν, [[john 2 25|Jhn.2:25;]] αὐ.ὑμεῖς, [[john 3 28|Jhn.3:28;]] καὶ αὐ. ἐγώ, [[romans 15 14|Rom.15:14;]] αὐ. Ἰησοῦς, [[john 2 24|Jhn.2:24;]] αὐ. καὶ οἱ μετ᾽ αὐτοῦ, [[mark 2 25|Mrk.2:25;]] ὑμεῖς αὐ., [[mark 6 31|Mrk.6:31;]] esp. (as freq in cl.) αὐ. ὁ, [[matthew 3 4|Mat.3:4]], [[mark 6 17|Mrk.6:17]], [[john 16 27|Jhn.16:27]], [[1-thessalonians 3 11|1Th.3:11]], al.; in late Gk., sometimes weakened, ἐν αὐτῇ τ. ὥρᾳ, in that hour, [[luke 10 21|Luk.10:21]] (M, Pr., 91; MM, see word); (2) emphatic, he, she, it (M, Pr., 86; Bl., §48, 1, 2, 7), [[matthew 1 21|Mat.1:21, 12:50]], [[luke 6 35|Luk.6:35]], al.; pointing to some one as master (cl.), [[matthew 8 24|Mat.8:24]], [[mark 4 38|Mrk.4:38]], al.; αὐ., καὶ αὐ. = οὗτος, ὁ δε (BL, §48, 1), [[matthew 14 2|Mat.14:2]], [[mark 14 15|Mrk.14:15, 44]], [[luke 1 22|Luk.1:22, 2:28]], al. 2. In oblique cases (cl.), for the simple pron. of 3rd of person(s), he, she, it, [[matthew 7 9|Mat.7:9, 10:12, 26:44]], al.; with ptcp. in genitive absol., [[matthew 9 18|Mat.9:18]], [[mark 13 1|Mrk.13:1]], al. (for irreg. constructions, V. Bl., §74, 5); pleonastically after the relative (cf. Heb. אֲשֶׁר לוֹ; WM, 184ff.; Bl., §50, 4; MM, see word), [[mark 7 25|Mrk.7:25]], [[revelation 3 8|Rev.3:8, 7:2]], al.; in constr. ad sensum, without proper subject expressly indicated, [[matthew 4 23|Mat.4:23]], [[acts 8 5|Act.8:5]], [[2-corinthians 2 13|2Co.2:13]], al.; genitive αὐτοῦ = ἐκείνου, [[romans 11 11|Rom.11:11]], [[1-thessalonians 2 19|1Th.2:19]], [[titus 3 5|Tit.3:5]], [[hebrews 2 4|Heb.2:4]]. 3. ὁ, ἡ, τὸ αὐ., the same: [[hebrews 1 12|Heb.1:12, 13:8]]; τὸ αὐ., ποιεῖν, [[matthew 5 46|Mat.5:46, 47]], al.; φρονεῖν, [[romans 12 16|Rom.12:16, 15:5]], [[philippians 2 2|Php.2:2]], al.; τὰ αὐ., [[acts 15 27|Act.15:27]], [[romans 2 1|Rom.2:1]], al.; κατὰ τὸ (τὰ) αὐ. (MM, see word), [[acts 14 1|Act.14:1]], [[luke 6 23|Luk.6:23]], al.; ἐπὶ τὸ αὐ., together (MM, see word), [[matthew 22 34|Mat.22:34]], [[acts 1 15|Act.1:15]], al.; ἓν κ. τὸ αὐ., [[1-corinthians 11 5|1Co.11:5, 12:11]]; with dative (cl.), [[1-corinthians 11 5|1Co.11:5;]] with a noun, λόγος, [[mark 14 39|Mrk.14:39;]] μέτρος, [[philippians 1 30|Php.1:30;]] πνεῦμα, [[1-corinthians 12 4|1Co.12:4.]] (AS)

αὐτοῦ adv., prop. neut. genitive of αὐτός, [in LXX for פֹּה, בָּזֶה ;] there: [[matthew 26 36|Mat.26:36]], [[mark 6 33|Mrk.6:33]], WH, mg., [[luke 9 27|Luk.9:27]], [[acts 15 34|Act.15:34]], WH, mg., R, mg., [[acts 18 19|Act.18:19 21:4]] .† (AS)
αὑτοῦ, -ῆς, -οῦ = ἑαυτοῦ (which see), [[matthew 6 34|Mat.6:34]], [[luke 12 17|Luk.12:17]], al. (MM, see word) (AS)
αὐτό-χειρ, -ρος, ὁ, ἡ (αὐτός, χείρ), with one's own hand: [[acts 27 19|Act.27:19.]]† (AS)
αὐχμηρός, -ά, -όν (αὐχμός, drought); 1. dry 2. squalid, dismal: [[2-peter 1 19|2Pe.1:19]] (MM, see word).† (AS)

ἀφ-αιρέω, -ῶ [in LXX (Cremer, 615 f.) for סוּר, עָבַר, H7311 כָּרַת, etc. (35 words in all) ;] to take from, take away, take off: with accusative, τὸ ὠτίον, [[matthew 26 51|Mat.26:51]], [[mark 14 47|Mrk.14:47]] (ὠτάριον, WH), [[luke 22 50|Luk.22:50]] (οὖς); ὄνειδος, [[luke 1 25|Luk.1:25;]] before ἀπό, [[revelation 22 19|Rev.22:19]], [[luke 16 3|Luk.16:3]] (mid.); pass., C. genitive, [[luke 10 42|Luk.10:42;]] ἀ. ἁμαρτίος, [[hebrews 10 4|Heb.10:4]], [[romans 11 27|Rom.11:27]] (mid.) (MM, see word).† (AS)
ἀφανής, -ές (φαίνω), [in LXX: [[nehemiah 4 8|Neh.4:8]](2), [[job 24 20|Job.24:20]], Sir.20:30 41:14, 2Ma.3:34 * ;] unseen, hidden: [[hebrews 4 13|Heb.4:13.]]† (AS)

ἀφανίζω (ἀφανής), [in LXX for שָׁמֵם ni., שָׁמַד hi., etc. ;] 1. to make unseen, hide from sight (Xen., a1.). 2. Later (MM, see word) (a) to destroy: [[matthew 6 19|Mat.6:19-20;]] (b) to disfigure: [[matthew 6 16|Mat.6:16.]] Pass., to vanish: [[james 4 14|Jas.4:14;]] to perish: [[acts 13 41|Act.13:41]](LXX).† (AS)
ἀφανισμός, -οῦ, ὁ (ἀφανίζω), [in LXX chiefly for שַׁמָּה, שְׁמָמָה ;] vanishing: [[hebrews 8 13|Heb.8:13.]]† (AS)
ἄφαντος, -ον (φαίνομαι), poët. and late prose (MM, see word) invisible, hidden: [[luke 24 31|Luk.24:31.]]† (AS)

ἀφεδρών, -ῶνος, ὁ (cf. ἄφεδρος, [[leviticus 12 5|Lev.12:5]]) = cl. ἄφοδος (MM, see word), a privy, drain: [[matthew 15 17|Mat.15:17]], [[mark 7 19|Mrk.7:19]] (ὀχετόν, WH, mg.).† **ὀχετός, -οῦ, ὁ (ὀχέω, to carry) [in Sm.: [[job 22 24|Job.22:24]], [[psalms 65 10|Psa.65:10]] al. ;] 1. a water-pipe, channel. 2. the intestinal canal: [[mark 7 19|Mrk.7:19]], WH, mg. (for ἀφεδρών).† (AS)
ἀφειδία (L, -εία), -ας, ἡ (ἀφειδής, unsparing); 1. extravagance. 2. unsparing treatment, severity: [[colossians 2 23|Col.2:23.]]† (AS)
ἀφελότης, -ητος, ἡ = cl. ἀφέλεια (see MM, see word), simplicity: [[acts 2 46|Act.2:46]]† (AS)

ἄφεσις, -εως, ἡ (ἀφίημι), [in LXX for יוֹבֵל, דְּרוֹר, etc. (see Deiss., BS, 98 ff.; MM, see word) ;] 1. dismissal, release: [[luke 4 18|Luk.4:18.]] 2. Metaphorical, of sins (never in LXX), pardon, remission of penalty: ἁμαρτιῶν, [[matthew 26 28|Mat.26:28]], [[mark 1 4|Mrk.1:4]], [[luke 1 77|Luk.1:77 3:3 24:47]], [[acts 2 38|Act.2:38 5:31 10:43 13:38 26:18]], [[colossians 1 14|Col.1:14]]; παραπτωμάτων, [[ephesians 1 7|Eph.1:7;]] absol., [[mark 3 29|Mrk.3:29]], [[hebrews 9 22|Heb.9:22 10:18]] (cf. DB, ii, 56; DCG, i, 437, ii, 605; Cremer, 297 f.).† SYN.: πάρεσις, which see (and cf. Tr., § xxxiii) (AS)
ἁφή, -ῆς, ἡ (ἅπτω, to fasten, fit), [in LXX for נֶגַע, frequently in Le ;] a joint (MM, see word): [[ephesians 4 16|Eph.4:16]], [[colossians 2 19|Col.2:19]] (Lft., in l).† (AS)

ἀφθαρσία, -ας, ἡ (ἄφθαρτος), [in LXX: Wis.2:23 6:19, 4Ma.9:22 4Mac 17:12 * ;] incorruptibility, immortality: [[romans 2 7|Rom.2:7]], [[1-corinthians 15 42|1Co.15:42 15:50 15:53-54]], [[2-timothy 1 10|2Ti.1:10]]; ἀγαπώντων . . . ἐν ἀ., [[ephesians 6 24|Eph.6:24]] (see AR, in l).† ἀ-φθορία, -ας, ἡ (φθείρω), [in LXX: [[haggai 2 17|Hag.2:17]] (שְׁדֵפָה)* ;] uncorruptness: [[titus 2 7|Tit.2:7]] (Rec. ἀφθορία).† (AS)

ἄ-φθαρτος, -ον (φθείρω), [in LXX: Wis.12:1 18:4 * ;] imperishable, immortal; (a) of things: [[1-corinthians 9 25|1Co.9:25]], [[1-peter 1 4|1Pe.1:4 1:23 3:4]]; (b) of persons: of men, [[1-corinthians 15 52|1Co.15:52;]] of God, [[romans 1 23|Rom.1:23]], [[1-timothy 1 17|1Ti.1:17]] (MM, see word).† (AS)

ἀφ-ίημι, [in LXX for נשׂא, נוח hi., נתן, סלח ni., עזב, etc. ;] 1. to send forth, send away, let go: of divorce (DB, iii, 274a), τ. γυναῖκα (Hdt.), [[1-corinthians 7 11|1Co.7:11-13;]] of death, τ. πνεῦμα ([[genesis 35 18|Gen.35:18]], Hdt., al.), [[matthew 27 50|Mat.27:50;]] (φωνήν, to utter a cry, [[mark 15 37|Mrk.15:37;]] of debts, to remit, forgive (cl.), τ. δανεῖον, [[matthew 18 27|Mat.18:27;]] τ. ὀφειλήν, [[matthew 18 32|Mat.18:32;]] esp. of sins (Cremer 296f.), τ. ἁμαρτίας, ἁμαρτήματα, ἀνομίας, [[matthew 9 2|Mat.9:2]], [[romans 4 7|Rom.4:7]]" (LXX), [[1-john 1 9|1Jn.1:9]], al.; punctiliar and iterative present (M, Pr., 119), Mrk.2:5, [[luke 11 4|Luk.11:4;]] Ion. pf., ἀφέωνται (M, Pr., 38), [[luke 5 23|Luk.5:23.]] 2. to leave alone, leave, neglect: [[matthew 4 11|Mat.4:11 5:24 15:14]], [[mark 1 20|Mrk.1:20, 31]] [[john 4 3|Jhn.4:3, 28]] al.; τ. ἐντολὴν τ. θεοῦ, [[mark 7 8|Mrk.7:8;]] τον̀ τ. ἀρχῆς τ. Χριστοῦ λόγον, [[hebrews 6 1|Heb.6:1;]] τ. ἀγάπην τ. πρώτην, [[revelation 2 4|Rev.2:4;]] ptcp., ἀφείς, pleonastic (as in Aram.; M, Pr., 14; Dalman, Words, 21f.), [[matthew 13 36|Mat.13:36 22:22]], [[mark 8 13|Mrk.8:13]], al. 3. to let, suffer, permit: [[matthew 3 15|Mat.3:15;]] with accusative, [[matthew 3 15|Mat.3:15, 19:14]], al.; with accusative of thing(s) and dative of person(s), [[matthew 5 40|Mat.5:40;]] with inf. pres., [[matthew 23 14|Mat.23:14]], al.; aor., [[mark 5 37|Mrk.5:37]], al.; in late Gk. (M, Pr., 175f.), before ἵνα, [[mark 11 16|Mrk.11:16]], [[john 12 7|Jhn.12:7]]; with subjunct. (M, Pr., l.with; Bl., §64, 2), [[matthew 7 4|Mat.7:4 27:49]], [[mark 15 36|Mrk.15:36]], [[luke 6 42|Luk.6:42]] (see further MM, see word). (AS)

ἀφ-ίημι, [in LXX for נשׂא, נוח hi., נתן, סלח ni., עזב, etc. ;] 1. to send forth, send away, let go: of divorce (DB, iii, 274a), τ. γυναῖκα (Hdt.), [[1-corinthians 7 11|1Co.7:11-13;]] of death, τ. πνεῦμα ([[genesis 35 18|Gen.35:18]], Hdt., al.), [[matthew 27 50|Mat.27:50;]] (φωνήν, to utter a cry, [[mark 15 37|Mrk.15:37;]] of debts, to remit, forgive (cl.), τ. δανεῖον, [[matthew 18 27|Mat.18:27;]] τ. ὀφειλήν, [[matthew 18 32|Mat.18:32;]] esp. of sins (Cremer 296f.), τ. ἁμαρτίας, ἁμαρτήματα, ἀνομίας, [[matthew 9 2|Mat.9:2]], [[romans 4 7|Rom.4:7]]" (LXX), [[1-john 1 9|1Jn.1:9]], al.; punctiliar and iterative present (M, Pr., 119), Mrk.2:5, [[luke 11 4|Luk.11:4;]] Ion. pf., ἀφέωνται (M, Pr., 38), [[luke 5 23|Luk.5:23.]] 2. to leave alone, leave, neglect: [[matthew 4 11|Mat.4:11 5:24 15:14]], [[mark 1 20|Mrk.1:20, 31]] [[john 4 3|Jhn.4:3, 28]] al.; τ. ἐντολὴν τ. θεοῦ, [[mark 7 8|Mrk.7:8;]] τον̀ τ. ἀρχῆς τ. Χριστοῦ λόγον, [[hebrews 6 1|Heb.6:1;]] τ. ἀγάπην τ. πρώτην, [[revelation 2 4|Rev.2:4;]] ptcp., ἀφείς, pleonastic (as in Aram.; M, Pr., 14; Dalman, Words, 21f.), [[matthew 13 36|Mat.13:36 22:22]], [[mark 8 13|Mrk.8:13]], al. 3. to let, suffer, permit: [[matthew 3 15|Mat.3:15;]] with accusative, [[matthew 3 15|Mat.3:15, 19:14]], al.; with accusative of thing(s) and dative of person(s), [[matthew 5 40|Mat.5:40;]] with inf. pres., [[matthew 23 14|Mat.23:14]], al.; aor., [[mark 5 37|Mrk.5:37]], al.; in late Gk. ἀφ-ίημι, [in LXX for נשׂא, נוח hi., נתן, סלח ni., עזב, etc. ;] 1. to send forth, send away, let go: of divorce (DB, iii, 274a), τ. γυναῖκα (Hdt.), [[1-corinthians 7 11|1Co.7:11-13;]] of death, τ. πνεῦμα ([[genesis 35 18|Gen.35:18]], Hdt., al.), [[matthew 27 50|Mat.27:50;]] (φωνήν, to utter a cry, [[mark 15 37|Mrk.15:37;]] of debts, to remit, forgive (cl.), τ. δανεῖον, [[matthew 18 27|Mat.18:27;]] τ. ὀφειλήν, [[matthew 18 32|Mat.18:32;]] esp. of sins (Cremer 296f.), τ. ἁμαρτίας, ἁμαρτήματα, ἀνομίας, [[matthew 9 2|Mat.9:2]], [[romans 4 7|Rom.4:7]]" (LXX), [[1-john 1 9|1Jn.1:9]], al.; punctiliar and iterative present (M, Pr., 119), Mrk.2:5, [[luke 11 4|Luk.11:4;]] Ion. pf., ἀφέωνται (M, Pr., 38), [[luke 5 23|Luk.5:23.]] 2. to leave alone, leave, neglect: [[matthew 4 11|Mat.4:11 5:24 15:14]], [[mark 1 20|Mrk.1:20, 31]] [[john 4 3|Jhn.4:3, 28]] al.; τ. ἐντολὴν τ. θεοῦ, [[mark 7 8|Mrk.7:8;]] τον̀ τ. ἀρχῆς τ. Χριστοῦ λόγον, [[hebrews 6 1|Heb.6:1;]] τ. ἀγάπην τ. πρώτην, [[revelation 2 4|Rev.2:4;]] ptcp., ἀφείς, pleonastic (as in Aram.; M, Pr., 14; Dalman, Words, 21f.), [[matthew 13 36|Mat.13:36 22:22]], [[mark 8 13|Mrk.8:13]], al. 3. to let, suffer, permit: [[matthew 3 15|Mat.3:15;]] with accusative, [[matthew 3 15|Mat.3:15, 19:14]], al.; with accusative of thing(s) and dative of person(s), [[matthew 5 40|Mat.5:40;]] with inf. pres., [[matthew 23 14|Mat.23:14]], al.; aor., [[mark 5 37|Mrk.5:37]], al.; in late Gk. (M, Pr., 175f.), before ἵνα, [[mark 11 16|Mrk.11:16]], [[john 12 7|Jhn.12:7]]; with subjunct. (M, Pr., l.with; Bl., §64, 2), [[matthew 7 4|Mat.7:4 27:49]], [[mark 15 36|Mrk.15:36]], [[luke 6 42|Luk.6:42]] (see further MM, see word). (AS)
ἀφ-ικνέομαι, -οῦμαι [in LXX for בּוֹא, etc. ;] perfective of ἱκνέομαι, to come (M, Pr., 247), to arrive at, come to, reach: metaphorically (MM, see word), [[romans 16 19|Rom.16:19.]]† (AS)
ἀ-φιλ-άγαθος, -ον without love of good: [[2-timothy 3 3|2Ti.3:3]] (not elsewhere in Gk. lit., but see MM, see word).† (AS)
ἀ-φιλ-άργυρος, -ον without love of money, not avaricious; [[1-timothy 3 3|1Ti.3:3]], [[hebrews 13 5|Heb.13:5]]. (For other instances, see MM, see word)† (AS)
ἄφ-ιξις, -εως, ἡ (ἀφικνέομαι), [in LXX: 3Ma.7:18 * ;] in cl. usually, arrival; rarely, departure: [[acts 20 29|Act.20:29]] (so in π., cf. MM, see word; M, [[proverbs 26 1|Pro.26:1-28]], n.).† (AS)

ἀφ-ίστημι [in LXX for סוּר, מָעַל, etc. (41 words in all) ;] 1. trans. in pres., impf., fut., 1 aor., to put away, lead away; metaphorically, to move to revolt: [[acts 5 37|Act.5:37.]] 2. Intrans. in pf., plpf., 2 aor., to stand off, depart from, withdraw from: with genitive, [[luke 2 37|Luk.2:37;]] before ἀπό, [[luke 4 13|Luk.4:13 13:27]], [[acts 5 38|Act.5:38 12:10 15:38 19:9 22:29]], [[2-corinthians 12 8|2Co.12:8]]; metaphorically, ἀπὸ ἀδικίας, [[2-timothy 2 19|2Ti.2:19;]] ἀπὸ θεοῦ, (fall away, apostatize), [[hebrews 3 12|Heb.3:12]] Mid. (exc. 1 aor., WH. is trans.), to withdraw oneself from, absent oneself from: [[luke 2 37|Luk.2:37;]] metaphorically, fall away, apostatize: absol., [[luke 8 13|Luk.8:13;]] with genitive, [[1-timothy 4 1|1Ti.4:1]] (MM, see word; Cremer, 308).† (AS)
ἄφνω adv., [in LXX for פִּתְאוֹם ;] suddenly: [[acts 2 2|Act.2:2 16:26 28:6]].† (AS)
ἀφόβως adv. (φόβος), [in LXX: [[proverbs 1 33|Pro.1:33]] (פַּחַד), Wis.17:4 * ;] without fear: [[luke 1 74|Luk.1:74]], [[philippians 1 14|Php.1:14]], [[1-corinthians 16 10|1Co.16:10]], Ju 12.† (AS)
ἀφ-ομοιόω, -ῶ [in LXX: Wis.13:14, Ep. [[jeremiah 1 5|Jer 1:5, 63, 71]]* ;] to make like: pass., [[hebrews 7 3|Heb.7:3.]]† (AS)

ἀφ-οράω, -ῶ [in LXX: 4Ma.17:10 (είς θεόν)* ;] (a) to look away from all else at, fix one's gaze upon: metaphorically (MM, see word), [[hebrews 12 2|Heb.12:2;]] (b) simply, to see: ἀφίδω (see: ἀπεῖδον, and Lft., Phi., in l; MM, see word), [[philippians 2 23|Php.2:23]] (see Ellic., in l).† (AS)

ἀφ-ορίζω [in LXX (Cremer, 805 f.) for בָּדַל hi., סָגַר hi., נוּף hi., רוּם hi etc. ;] (a) to mark off by boundaries from, separate from: with accusative, [[acts 19 9|Act.19:9]], [[galatians 2 12|Gal.2:12]]; id. before ἐκ (ἀπό), [[matthew 13 49|Mat.13:49 25:32]] (MM, see word); of excom­munication, [[luke 6 22|Luk.6:22.]] Pass., absol., [[2-corinthians 6 17|2Co.6:17;]] (b) to set apart, devote to a special purpose (before εἰς): with accusative, [[galatians 1 15|Gal.1:15.]] Mid., [[acts 13 2|Act.13:2]], [[romans 1 1|Rom.1:1]] (DB, iii 588).† (AS)

ἀφ-ορμή, -ῆς, ἡ [in LXX: [[ezekiel 5 7|Eze.5:7]] (הָמוֹן), [[proverbs 9 9|Pro.9:9]], 3Ma.3:2 * ;] prop., a starting point; in war, a base of operations; metaphorically, an occasion, incentive, opportunity (MM, see word): [[2-corinthians 11 12|2Co.11:12]], [[galatians 5 13|Gal.5:13]]; ἀφ. λαμβάνειν, [[luke 11 24|Luk.11:24]], WH, mg., [[romans 7 8|Rom.7:8, 11]]; ἀφ. διδόναι, [[2-corinthians 5 12|2Co.5:12]], [[1-timothy 5 14|1Ti.5:14]].* (AS)
ἀφρίζω (ἀφρός), to foam at the mouth: [[mark 9 18|Mrk.9:18, 20]].† (AS)
foam , of the sea, (Iliad by Homer): of an angry lion, foam, froth , (Iliad by Homer); ἀπ᾽ ἀνθρώπων ἀφρόν frothy blood , (Aeschulus Tragicus) (ML)
ἀφροσύνη, -ης, ἡ (ἄφρων), [in LXX for אִוֶּלֶת, נְבָלָה, etc. ;] foolishness: [[mark 7 22|Mrk.7:22]], [[2-corinthians 11 1|2Co.11:1 11:17 11:21]].† (AS)

ἄφρων, -ον genitive -ονος (φρήν), [in LXX for כְּסִיל, נָבָל, etc. ;] without reason, senseless, foolish, expressing "want of mental sanity and sobriety, a reckless and inconsiderate habit of mind" (Hort; cf. MM, see word): [[luke 11 40|Luk.11:40 12:20]], [[romans 2 20|Rom.2:20]], [[1-corinthians 15 36|1Co.15:36]], [[2-corinthians 11 16|2Co.11:16 12:6 12:11]], [[1-peter 2 15|1Pe.2:15]]; opposite to φρόνιμος, [[2-corinthians 11 19|2Co.11:19;]] to συνιέντες, [[ephesians 2 17|Eph.2:17.]]† (AS)
ἀφ-υπιόω, -ῶ (ὑπνόω, to put to sleep), [in Al.: [[genesis 28 11|Gen.28:11]] * ;] 1. to awake from sleep (Anth.). 2. = cl. καθυπνόω (MM, see word), to fall asleep: [[luke 8 23|Luk.8:23.]]† (AS)

ἀφωνος, -ον (φωνή) [in LXX: [[isaiah 53 7|Isa.53:7]] (עָלַם ni.), Wis.4:19, 2Ma.3:29 * ;] dumb, speechless: [[acts 8 32|Act.8:32]] (LXX); of idols (MM, see word), [[1-corinthians 12 2|1Co.12:2;]] of beasts, [[2-peter 2 19|2Pe.2:19;]] τοσαῦτα γένη φωνῶν καὶ οὐδὲν ἄ.—so many kinds of voices and none voiceless, i.e. without signification, unintelligible: [[1-corinthians 14 10|1Co.14:10.]]† (AS)
Ἄχαζ (WH, Ἄχας), ὁ (Heb. אָחָז), Ahaz: [[matthew 1 9|Mat.1:9.]]† (AS)

Ἀχαία (T, Ἀχαΐα), -ας, ἡ (Bl., § 46, 11) Achaia, the Roman province: [[acts 18 12|Act.18:12, 27 19:21]] [[romans 15 26|Rom.15:26]], [[1-corinthians 16 15|1Co.16:15]], [[2-corinthians 1 1|2Co.1:1 9:2 11:10]], [[1-thessalonians 1 7|1Th.1:7-8]].† (AS)
Ἀχαϊκός, -οῦ, ὁ Achaicus: [[1-corinthians 16 17|1Co.16:17.]]† (AS)
ἀχάριστος, -ον (χαρίζομαι), [in LXX: Wis.16:29, Sir.29:17, 25, 4Ma.9:10 * ;] (a) ungracious, unpleasing; (b) ungrateful, thankless: [[luke 6 35|Luk.6:35]], [[2-timothy 3 2|2Ti.3:2]].† (AS)
Ἀχείμ, ὁ Achim: [[matthew 1 14|Mat.1:14.]]† (AS)

ἀ-χειρο-ποίητος, -ον (χειροποίητος) not made by hands: [[mark 14 58|Mrk.14:58]], [[2-corinthians 5 1|2Co.5:1]]; metaphorically, περιτομή ἀ. (i.e. spiritual ), [[colossians 2 11|Col.2:11]] (MM, see word).† (AS)
ἀχλύς, -ύος, ἡ [in Aq.: [[ezekiel 12 7|Eze.12:7;]] Sm.: [[job 3 5|Job.3:5]] * ;] a mist, esp. a dimness of the eyes: [[acts 13 11|Act.13:11]] (see Tr., Syn., § with).† (AS)

ἀ-χρεῖος, -ον (χρεῖος, useful), [in LXX: [[2-samuel 6 22|2Ki.6:22]] (שָׁפָל), Ep. [[jeremiah 17 1|Jer.17:1-27]] * ;] useless, unprofitable: [[matthew 25 30|Mat.25:30]], [[luke 17 10|Luk.17:10]] (MM, see word).† (AS)
ἀχρεόω (Rec. -ειόω, Polyb., LXX), -ῶ (ἄχρεος = ἀχρεῖος) [in LXX (-ειόω) for אָלַח ni., etc. ;] to make useless, unprofitable: pass., [[romans 3 12|Rom.3:12]] (LXX).† (AS)
ά-χρηατος, -ον [in LXX: [[hosea 8 8|Hos.8:8]] (חֵפֶץ אַיִן), Wis.2:11, Sir.16:1, al. ;] useless; unserviceable: opposite to εὔχρηστος, Phm 11.† (AS)

ἄχρι (and Epic ἄχρις, bef. vowel (see MM, see word), [[romans 11 25|Rom.11:25]] T, [[galatians 3 19|Gal.3:19]] T, WH, mg., [[hebrews 3 13|Heb.3:13]]); 1. adv., utterly (Hom.). 2. Prep. with genitive, until, unto, as far as; (a) of time [[acts 3 21|Act.3:21 22:22]], [[romans 1 13|Rom.1:13 5:13]], [[1-corinthians 4 11|1Co.4:11]], [[2-corinthians 3 14|2Co.3:14]], [[galatians 4 2|Gal.4:2]], [[philippians 1 6|Php.1:6]]; ἄ. καιροῦ, [[luke 4 13|Luk.4:13]], [[acts 13 11|Act.13:11]]; ἄ. ἧς ἡμέρας, [[matthew 24 38|Mat.24:38]], [[luke 1 20|Luk.1:20 17:27]], [[acts 1 2|Act.1:2]] (τῆς ἡ. ἧς), [[acts 1 22|Act.1:22;]] ἄ. ταύτης τ. ἡμέρας (τ. ἡ. ταύτης), [[acts 2 29|Act.2:29 23:1 26:22]]; ἄ. ἡμερων πέντε, [[acts 20 6|Act.20:6;]] ἄ. αὐγῆς, [[acts 20 11|Act.20:11;]] ἄ. τοῦ νῦν, [[romans 8 22|Rom.8:22]], [[philippians 1 5|Php.1:5]]; ἄ. τέλους, [[hebrews 6 11|Heb.6:11]], [[revelation 2 26|Rev.2:26]]; (b) of space: [[acts 11 5|Act.11:5 13:6 20:4]] (R, txt., WH, mg.) [[acts 28 15|Act.28:15]], [[2-corinthians 10 13|2Co.10:13-14]], [[hebrews 4 12|Heb.4:12]], [[revelation 14 20|Rev.14:20 18:5]]; (with) of measure or degree: ἄ. θανάτου, [[acts 22 4|Act.22:4]], [[revelation 2 10|Rev.2:10 12:11]]. 3. As conj., until; (a) ἄχρι alone: with subj. aor., [[galatians 3 19|Gal.3:19]] (ἄ. οὗ T, WH, mg.); id. without ἄν (Bl., § 65, 10), [[revelation 7 3|Rev.7:3 15:8 20:3, 5]]; with indic. fut., [[revelation 17 17|Rev.17:17;]] (b) ἄ. οὗ (i.e. ἄ.. τούτου ᾧ): with indic. aor., [[acts 7 18|Act.7:18;]] impf., [[acts 27 33|Act.27:33;]] with subj. aor. (Bl., ut supr.), [[luke 21 24|Luk.21:24]], [[romans 11 25|Rom.11:25]], [[1-corinthians 11 26|1Co.11:26 15:25]], [[galatians 3 19|Gal.3:19]], T, WH, mg.; id. with ἄν, [[revelation 2 25|Rev.2:25;]] with indic. pres., while, [[hebrews 3 13|Heb.3:13]] (cf. μέχρι).† (AS)
ἄχυρον, -ον, τό [in LXX chiefly for תֶּבֶן ;] chaff: [[matthew 3 12|Mat.3:12]], [[luke 3 17|Luk.3:17]].† (AS)
ἀ-ψευδής, -ές (ψεῦδος), [in LXX: Wis.7:17 * ;] free from false-hood, truthful: [[titus 1 2|Tit.1:2.]]† (AS)
ἄψινθος, -ου, ἡ (also ἀψίνθιον, τό; ἀψινθία, ἡ), wormwood: as a proper name, [[revelation 8 11|Rev.8:11.]]† (AS)
ἄψυχος, -ον (ψυχή), [in LXX: Wis.13:17 14:29 * ;] inanimate, lifeless: [[1-corinthians 14 7|1Co.14:7.]]† (AS)

Βάαλ (Rec. βαάλ), ὁ, ἡ, indecl. (Heb. בַּעַל, lord), Baal: [[romans 11 4|Rom.11:4]] (LXX). The fem. art. here agrees with the usage of LXX, where, following a similar Hebrew practice (בֹּשֶׁת for בַּעַל), αἰσχύνη appears to have been substituted in reading for the written Βάαλ (cf. [[1-kings 18 19|3Ki.18:19]]), and to account for the frequently use of the fem. art. bef. Β. The usage, however, is not general, and in the passage cited in Ro ([[1-kings 19 18|3Ki.19:18]]), LXX reads τῷ Β. † (AS)

Βαβυλών, -ῶνος, ἡ (בָּבֶל, Heb. form of Assyr. Bab-ili, Gate of God), Babylon: [[matthew 1 11|Mat.1:11, 12 17]], [[acts 7 43|Act.7:43]]" (LXX) ; symbolically, of Rome: [[revelation 14 8|Rev.14:8 16:19 17:5 18:2, 10, 21]], and prob. also [[1-peter 5 13|1Pe.5:13.]]† (AS)

βάθος, -εος (-ους), τό, [in LXX for מְצוּלָה ,תַּחְתִּי, etc. ;] depth: [[matthew 13 5|Mat.13:5]], [[mark 4 5|Mrk.4:5]], [[romans 8 39|Rom.8:39]], [[ephesians 3 18|Eph.3:18]]; τὸ β., the deep sea: [[luke 5 4|Luk.5:4;]] metaphorically, β. πλούτου . . .
